biography.value:
Kharzoryx, the Blue Pyre

Species: Voorz’zt Coldfire Wyrm
Abyssal Origin: Layer 47 of Azzagrat — Voorz’zt
Palanthas Anchor: the northern approaches and the city's physical laws of heat, cold, destruction, and defence.

Voorz’zt lies beneath a wan blue sun where thermal laws contradict themselves. Kharzoryx breathes blue fire that freezes and commands frost that burns. Its approach causes hearths to rim with ice and snow to scorch skin.
biography.public: A colossal demonic wyrm wreathed in blue flame whose heat freezes and whose frost burns.

source.license: Private campaign material. Not for distribution.

description.value: The wyrm makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with [[/item Inversion Pulse]].
[[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage 3d10 + @abilities.str.mod type=slashing average=true]] plus [[/damage 1d10 type=fire average=true]] plus [[/damage 1d10 type=cold average=true]] damage.

Dexterity Saving Throw: [[/save dex 26 format=long]], each creature in a 120-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage 10d10 type=cold average=true]] plus [[/damage 10d10 type=fire average=true]] damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, its Fire and Cold Resistance provide no benefit, and Fire or Cold Immunity counts only as Resistance against the corresponding damage type. Success: Half damage with no additional effect.

Creatures of the wyrm's choice within 20 feet make a [[/save con 25 format=long]]. Failure: [[/damage 4d10 type=fire average=true]] plus [[/damage 4d10 type=cold average=true]] damage, and the creature cannot regain Hit Points until the beginning of the wyrm's next turn. Success: Half damage.

The wyrm teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Creatures within 10 feet of the space it leaves make a [[/save dex 25 format=long]] or take [[/damage 3d10 type=cold average=true]] damage.

Trigger: The wyrm would take Fire or Cold damage. Before resistances and immunities are applied, it changes that instance to the opposite damage type. If this causes the wyrm to take no damage, the creature that caused the damage takes [[/damage 2d10 average=true]] damage of the converted type.

The wyrm can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures; those spaces are difficult terrain. The first time on a turn it enters another creature's space, that creature must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take [[/damage 4d10 type=bludgeoning average=true]] damage, be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, and have the Prone condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
The wyrm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

While within Abyssal Palanthas, the wyrm is considered to be inside its lair. Its death permanently damages the planar correspondence between its native layer of Azzagrat and the mortal city of Palanthas. Kharzoryx anchors Voorz’zt to the northern approaches of Palanthas and to the city's laws of heat and cold.
Whenever the wyrm deals Fire or Cold damage, it may change that damage to the other type before the damage is resolved. This is not spellcasting and cannot be Counterspelled.
If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. In its lair it has 5 uses; outside its lair reduce the maximum to 4.

Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the wyrm can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Pyre Rend. The wyrm makes one Rend attack.

Coldfire Flight. The wyrm flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Inversion Burst. Fire and cold erupt simultaneously around the wyrm.

The wyrm flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Creatures within 20 feet make a [[/save dex 25 format=long]], taking [[/damage 4d10 type=fire average=true]] plus [[/damage 4d10 type=cold average=true]] damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the wyrm can use one lair action; it cannot use the same lair action two rounds in a row unless the GM chooses otherwise for a mythic scene.

Blue Furnace. A 20-foot-radius region erupts in blue flame. Creatures there make a [[/save dex 25 format=long]], taking [[/damage 6d10 type=cold average=true]] damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

Burning Frost. A 60-foot-long, 20-foot-wide freezing gale erupts. Creatures in it make a [[/save con 25 format=long]], taking [[/damage 6d10 type=fire average=true]] damage and being pushed 30 feet on a failure, or half as much damage without the push on a success.

Invert the World. Until initiative count 20 of the next round, all Fire damage dealt inside the lair becomes Cold damage, and all Cold damage becomes Fire damage.
